sn22.55:1.3: “no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissatīti
sn22.55:1.5: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.55:1.6: “yathākathaṃ pana bhante, no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissatīti,
sn22.55:2.1: idha bhikkhu, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido
sn22.55:2.2: sappurisadhamme avinīto, rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.55:2.3: vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā vedanaṃ, vedanāya vā attānaṃ.
sn22.55:2.5: saṅkhāre attato samanupassati, saṃkhāravantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saṅkhāre, saṅkhāresu vā attānaṃ.
sn22.55:2.6: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.55:3.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ, ‘aniccaṃ rūpa’nti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti,
sn22.55:7.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhū, ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.55:7.2: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati. na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ, na vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, na vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā vedanaṃ, na vedanāya vā attānaṃ, na saññaṃ …pe…
sn22.55:7.6: na saṅkhāresu vā attānaṃ. na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati. na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.55:8.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ ‘aniccaṃ rūpanti’ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.55:8.6: dukkhaṃ rūpaṃ ‘dukkhaṃ rūpanti’ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ …pe… dukkhaṃ saññaṃ …pe… dukkhe saṅkhāre …pe… dukkhaṃ viññāṇaṃ ‘dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti’ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.55:8.7: anattaṃ rūpaṃ ‘anattaṃ rūpanti’ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. anattaṃ vedanaṃ …pe… anattaṃ saññaṃ …pe… anatte saṅkhāre …pe… anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ ‘anattaṃ viññāṇanti’ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.55:8.8: saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ ‘saṅkhataṃ rūpanti’ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. saṅkhataṃ vedanaṃ …pe… saṅkhataṃ saññaṃ …pe… saṅkhate saṅkhāre …pe… saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ ‘saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti’ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.55:9.1: so rūpassa vibhavā, vedanāya vibhavā, saññāya vibhavā, saṅkhārānaṃ vibhavā, viññāṇassa vibhavā, evaṃ kho bhikkhu
sn22.55:9.2: “no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissatī”ti,
sn22.55:9.4: evaṃ vimuccamāno bhante, bhikkhu chindeyyorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānīti.
sn22.55:10.1: “kathaṃ pana bhante, jānato kathaṃ pana passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotī”ti?
sn22.55:10.2: idha bhikkhu, assutavā puthujjano atasitāye ṭhāne tāsaṃ āpajjati.
sn22.55:10.4: “no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissatī’ti.
sn22.55:11.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhu, ariyasāvako atasitāye ṭhāne na tāsaṃ āpajjati.
sn22.55:11.2: na heso bhikkhu, tāso sutavato ariyasāvakassa
sn22.55:11.3: no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati. na me bhavissatīti.
sn22.55:11.4: rūpupayaṃ vā bhikkhu, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūpārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasecanaṃ, vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn22.55:11.7: saṅkhārūpayaṃ vā bhikkhu, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, saṅkhārārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn22.55:12.2: ahamaññatra rūpā, aññatra vedanāya, aññatra saññāya, aññatra saṅkhārehi viññāṇassa āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā cutiṃ vā uppattiṃ vā vuddhiṃ vā virūḷhiṃ vā vepullaṃ vā paññāpessāmīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn22.55:13.1: rūpadhātuyā ce bhikkhu, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti. rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
sn22.55:13.5: viññāṇadhātuyā ce bhikkhu, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti. rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
sn22.55:13.7: vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ yeva parinibbāyati.
sn22.55:13.8: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn22.55:13.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti.
